items.title: Detect worktree-vs-mirror phase divergence in createHandoffPack and surface in handoff_create output
items.context: In createHandoffPack (core/lattice-handoff.ts) call resolveStoryAuthority(store, root, {storyIds:[storyId], activeOnly:false}); when a linked worktree exists and authoritativePhase !== mirrorPhase, attach an optional phaseAuthorityWarning {mirrorPhase, authoritativePhase, worktreePath, message} to the pack. Field MUST NOT be part of HandoffPackHashInput/computeHandoffPackHash so existing packHash values are unchanged; normalizeHandoffPack must preserve it. Resolver errors must be caught and treated as no-warning. Render a warning line in handoff_create text output and include the field in JSON output.
items.userSees: Running handoff_create for a story whose worktree is ahead prints a clear 'worktree phase X is ahead of packed mirror phase Y' warning; running it for an in-sync story prints no warning and produces an identical packHash to before.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke covers buildPhaseAuthorityWarning (ahead/in-sync/no-worktree/divergent) + packHash byte-stability. Live: handoff_create on real divergent B-4e06 prints '⚠ phaseAuthority (ahead): ...DEV is ahead of...INIT_CHECK'; no-worktree B-decb prints none; recoveryPoint.phase unchanged.

items.title: Surface the same warning in handoff_inspect and cover with a focused smoke test
items.context: inspectHandoffPack must carry phaseAuthorityWarning into HandoffInspection and renderHandoffInspectionText must render it. Add a focused smoke (tasks/) that builds a pack with a worktree ahead of mirror and asserts the warning appears in create+inspect output, asserts absence when in sync, and asserts packHash is byte-identical for the in-sync case.
items.userSees: lattice handoff_inspect on a stale-phase pack shows the phase-authority warning; the regression suite proves the warning fires only on divergence and never perturbs packHash.
